response.overview: Greetings, beautiful shopper.  Penny Wise, A Dollar Foolish is a virtual entry into Concord Mall, Delaware’s second-largest shopping mall.  Experience the glory of the north entrance on the west side of the mall. Once inside, you may rejoice in live tax-free shopping, instant cash for phones, and one-cent wishes at our center fountain.  Thanks for shopping!
response.title: Penny Wise, A Dollar Foolish
